name: ViDoRe v3
description: ViDoRe v3 is the most comprehensive ViDoRe release, extending the benchmark from pure retrieval to full RAG pipeline evaluation across 10 enterprise domains (8 public, 2 private). It introduces 7 query types (extractive, open-ended, compare-contrast, enumerative, numerical, boolean, multi-hop), ~26,000 document pages, 3,099 human-verified queries, and 6-language query translations per dataset. Best SOTA sits at ~65.6% nDCG@10, indicating substantial headroom.
reputation: Most ambitious ViDoRe release; 12,000 annotation hours, commercially permissive license, and collaboration between ILLUIN Technology and NVIDIA. Addresses real-world enterprise RAG use cases.
notes: 10 domains: finance (EN+FR), computer science, HR, energy, industrial (USAF technical orders), pharmaceuticals/FDA, physics, nuclear energy (private), telecom standards (private). ~26,000 pages, 12,000 annotation hours. 6-language query translations (EN, FR, ES, DE, IT, PT). 7 query types mirror real enterprise retrieval scenarios. arXiv:2601.08620.
